ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels in the central regions vs 25% low-intensity black pixels forming a thick peripheral border.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity (white) field occupying the interior of both lobes, bifurcated by the central notch. This is encapsulated by a continuous, irregular low-intensity (black) margin along the trailing edge and lateral tips. Scattered low-intensity focal spots are present within the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch depth is roughly 1/6th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; significant jagged variations (peaks and valleys) of 5-15 pixels in amplitude, particularly dense on the medial side of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in acute, tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10-12 discrete, low-intensity circular pixel clusters scattered across the white surface of the left lobe, and 3-5 on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct detection of at least four parallel, sub-vertical low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) on the mid-section of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation/missing segment on the trailing edge of the left lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
